# Every class name legacy/app.css declared on 2026-09-08, when the file was frozen.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. legacy-frozen.test.js asserts the stylesheet declares no
# name that is not in here — so an existing rule can be deleted freely, and a NEW one
# cannot be added at all. When a redesign cycle deletes a screen's CSS, delete its names
# from this file in the same commit; that diff is the record of the progress.
#
# Regenerate the survivors with:
#   node -e "..." — see the test, which prints the exact command on failure.
